```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, cache = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = TRUE)
```

```{r libs}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ape)
  library(phytools)
  library(ggtree)   # only for fortify() on a phylo, to derive the tip order
})

.src <- function(p) source(if (file.exists(p)) p else file.path("..", "..", p))
.src("workflow/scripts/functions.R")
.src("workflow/scripts/palettes.R")
```

```{r paths}
P <- as.list(params)
res <- function(...) rp(file.path(P$results, ...))
rsc <- function(...) rp(file.path(P$resources, ...))
have <- function(p) !is.null(p) && length(p) == 1L && nzchar(p) && file.exists(rp(p))

HAVE_TREES <- have(file.path(P$tree_dir, "ar53_reduced.tree")) &&
  have(file.path(P$tree_dir, "bac120_reduced.tree")) &&
  have(file.path(P$resources, "etol.nwk"))
HAVE_NR    <- have(P$nr_counts) && have(P$clustnr_counts)
HAVE_ECOLI <- HAVE_NR && have(P$ecoli_ids)

message("trees: ", HAVE_TREES, " | nr: ", HAVE_NR, " | ecoli: ", HAVE_ECOLI)
```

# Per-organism table

```{r parse-data}
# results/meta/<db>_meta.tsv (workflow/scripts/analyze_stats.R) is the
# per-organism provenance table: source_db, the harmonized 7 ranks, data_type,
# completeness (BUSCO for eukaryotes / CheckM2 for GTDB), the decontamination
# flagging and the seqkit size stats.
meta <- read_delim(res("meta", "repdb_meta.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# CheckM2 *contamination* is the one prokaryotic field not propagated into the
# meta table, so take it straight from the GTDB metadata
gtdb <- read_delim(res("meta", "gtdb_meta.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    mnemo = gsub("^GB|^RS|\\..*", "", gsub("_", "", accession)),
    checkm2_contamination
  )

# data_type is normalized (lower case) upstream; map it onto the palette labels
pretty_type <- function(x) {
  lut <- c(
    "genome"                    = "Genome",
    "genome (de novo sequencing)" = "Genome",
    "complete genome"           = "Complete genome",
    "chromosome"                = "Chromosome",
    "scaffold"                  = "Scaffold",
    "contig"                    = "Contig",
    "single-cell"               = "S.C. genome",
    "single-cell genome"        = "S.C. genome",
    "transcriptome"             = "Transcriptome",
    "single-cell transcriptome" = "S.C. transcriptome",
    "est"                       = "EST",
    "transcriptome,est"         = "EST"
  )
  out <- unname(lut[tolower(x)])
  ifelse(is.na(out) & !is.na(x), str_to_sentence(x), out)
}

contam_file <- res("dbs", "repdb", "decontaminate", "contaminants.txt")
if (file.exists(contam_file)) {
  cont_ids <- readLines(contam_file, warn = FALSE)
  cont_ids <- cont_ids[nzchar(cont_ids)]
  contam_tally <- tibble(mnemo = str_split_i(cont_ids, "_", 2)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mnemo)) %>%
    count(mnemo, name = "n_conts_file")
} else {
  contam_tally <- tibble(mnemo = character(0), n_conts_file = integer(0))
}
HAVE_CONTAM_FILE <- nrow(contam_tally) > 0

repdb_df <- meta %>%
  left_join(gtdb, by = "mnemo") %>%
  left_join(contam_tally, by = "mnemo") %>%
  mutate(
    db = source_db,
    label = case_when(
      k %in% c("Bacteria", "Archaea") ~ p,
      k %in% c("Eukaryota", "Viruses") ~ c
    ),
    type = pretty_type(data_type),
    n_conts = if (HAVE_CONTAM_FILE) {
      replace_na(n_conts_file, 0L)
    } else {
      replace_na(n_contaminants, 0L)
    },
    mmseqs_contamination = if_else(num_seqs > 0, n_conts / num_seqs * 100, NA_real_),
    contamination = case_when(
      k %in% c("Bacteria", "Archaea") ~ checkm2_contamination,
      k == "Eukaryota" ~ mmseqs_contamination
    )
  )

tax <- repdb_df %>% select(mnemo, k, p, c, o, f, g, s)

contam_check <- tibble(
  Source = c("contaminants.txt (recomputed here)", "repdb_meta.tsv (n_contaminants)"),
  `Flagged sequences` = c(
    if (HAVE_CONTAM_FILE) sum(contam_tally$n_conts_file) else NA_integer_,
    sum(meta$n_contaminants, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  `Organisms affected` = c(
    if (HAVE_CONTAM_FILE) sum(contam_tally$mnemo %in% meta$mnemo) else NA_integer_,
    sum(meta$n_contaminants > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(Used = c(HAVE_CONTAM_FILE, !HAVE_CONTAM_FILE))

message(nrow(repdb_df), " organisms; ",
        sum(repdb_df$n_conts), " flagged contaminant sequences")

clust_stats <- read_delim(res("stats", "repdb_clustered_stats.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    c = str_remove(basename(file), "\\.(faa|fa|fasta)(\\.gz)?$"),
    db = "clust_repdb"
  ) %>%
  select(c, num_seqs, db)

virus_raw <- read_delim(rsc("ncbi_virus_metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(mnemo = gsub("_|\\..*", "", Assembly))
virus_groups <- read_delim(res("meta", "refseq_virus_groups.tsv"),
  col_names = c("realm", "kingdom", "p"), show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kingdom))

virus_df <- repdb_df %>%
  filter(k == "Viruses") %>%
  select(mnemo, k, p, c, s, num_seqs, label) %>%
  left_join(virus_groups, by = "p") %>%
  left_join(virus_raw, by = "mnemo")
```

# Disk footprint and build benchmarks

```{r footprint}
db_files <- c(
  "FASTA (gzipped)" = res("dbs", "repdb", "repdb.fa.gz"),
  "DIAMOND index"   = res("dbs", "repdb", "repdb_diamond.dmnd"),
  "Clustered FASTA (gzipped)" = res("dbs", "repdb", "repdb_clustered.fa.gz")
)
mmseqs_sz <- sum(file.size(list.files(res("dbs", "repdb"),
  pattern = "^repdb_mmseqs", full.names = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE)

footprint <- tibble(
  Artifact = c(names(db_files), "MMseqs2 index"),
  Bytes = c(unname(file.size(db_files)), mmseqs_sz)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Bytes), Bytes > 0) %>%
  mutate(GB = Bytes / 2^30)

bench_files <- list.files(res("benchmarks", "dbs", "repdb"),
  pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
bench_build <- if (length(bench_files)) {
  map_dfr(bench_files, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(Step = str_remove(basename(.x), "\\.txt$"), .before = 1)) %>%
    select(Step, any_of(c("s", "h:m:s", "max_rss", "max_vms", "cpu_time")))
} else NULL
```

# Backbone trees

```{bash obtain-reduced-prokatree, eval=FALSE, engine="sh"}
# Run once from the directory holding the GTDB reference trees (ar53.tree,
# bac120.tree); `results/` is the finished RepDBmaker run. Column 20 of
# gtdb_meta.tsv is the GTDB lineage.
cut -f1,20 results/meta/gtdb_meta.tsv | grep "d__Archaea" | sed 's/;c.*.//g' | sed 's/d__.*.p__//g' > armap
# the only problem is that phyla with one genome (Huberarchaeota and JACRDV01)
# are not collapsed - the mysterious bug in nw_rename
nw_prune ar53.tree GB_GCA_003724275.1 | nw_rename - armap | nw_condense - > ar53_reduced.tree

cut -f1,20 results/meta/gtdb_meta.tsv | grep "d__Bacteria" | sed 's/;c.*.//g' | sed 's/d__.*.p__//g' > bacmap
nw_rename bac120.tree bacmap | nw_condense - > bac120_reduced.tree
```

```{r trees}
eukaproka_tree <- virtree <- repdb_classtree <- NULL

if (HAVE_TREES) {
  artree  <- read.tree(rp(file.path(P$tree_dir, "ar53_reduced.tree")))
  bactree <- read.tree(rp(file.path(P$tree_dir, "bac120_reduced.tree")))
  euktree <- read.tree(rsc("etol.nwk"))

  v_fct <- virus_df %>%
    distinct(k, realm, kingdom, p, c) %>%
    filter(!grepl("unclassi", p), !grepl("unclassi", c)) %>%
    mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

  virtree <- as.phylo.formula(~ k / realm / kingdom / p / c, data = v_fct)

  tmp <- bind.tip(bactree, tip.label = "archaea", where = length(bactree$tip.label) + 1)
  tmp <- root(tmp, "archaea", resolve.root = T)
  tmp <- bind.tree(tmp, artree, where = which(tmp$tip.label == "archaea"))
  tmp <- bind.tip(tmp, tip.label = "euk", where = which(grepl("Asgardarchaeota", tmp$tip.label)))
  eukaproka_tree <- bind.tree(tmp, euktree, where = which(tmp$tip.label == "euk"))
  tmp <- bind.tip(eukaproka_tree, tip.label = "vir",
                  where = length(eukaproka_tree$tip.label) + 1)
  tmp <- root(tmp, "vir", resolve.root = T)
  repdb_classtree <- bind.tree(tmp, virtree, where = which(tmp$tip.label == "vir"))

  p_order <- fortify(repdb_classtree) %>%
    filter(isTip) %>% arrange(desc(y)) %>% pull(label)
} else {
  # the eukaryotic panels order their y axis by the backbone tree; without it,
  # fall back to a taxonomy-driven ordering so the report still renders
  p_order <- repdb_df %>%
    distinct(k, p, label) %>% filter(!is.na(label)) %>%
    arrange(k, p, label) %>% pull(label)
}
```

# Co-occurrence of contaminants


```{r co-occurrence}
pair_cooc <- read_delim(res("dbs", "repdb", "decontaminate", "pair_counts.tsv"),
  col_names = c("n", "tmpq", "tmpt"), show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(q = pmin(tmpq, tmpt), t = pmax(tmpq, tmpt)) %>%
  select(-contains("tmp")) %>%
  group_by(q, t) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

message("pair_counts: ", nrow(pair_cooc), " unique pairs")

euk_mnemos <- repdb_df$mnemo[repdb_df$k == "Eukaryota"]

mixed_pairs <- pair_cooc %>%
  mutate(
    euka  = ifelse(q %in% euk_mnemos, q, t),
    proka = ifelse(q %in% euk_mnemos, t, q)
  ) %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("euka" = "mnemo")) %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("proka" = "mnemo")) %>%
  filter(k.x == "Eukaryota" & k.y != "Eukaryota")

cooc_by_genus <- mixed_pairs %>%
  count(euka, donor_k = k.y, clade = g.y, name = "n")

RANKS <- c("k", "p", "c", "o", "f", "g", "s")

mixed <- read_delim(res("dbs", "repdb", "decontaminate", "mixed_cluster.tsv"),
  col_names = c("rep", "seq", "taxid", "tax"), delim = "\t",
  show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE
) %>%
  separate(tax, RANKS, sep = ";", fill = "right") %>%
  transmute(rep, seq, mnemo = str_split_i(seq, "_", 2), k, p, f, g)

# the authoritative flagged set (get_contaminants.R), one row per flagged protein
cont <- read_delim(res("dbs", "repdb", "decontaminate", "contaminants.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(euka = str_split_i(seq, "_", 2), seq, rep)

message("mixed clusters: ", n_distinct(mixed$rep),
        " | flagged proteins: ", nrow(cont))

# full detail for the two proteomes discussed in the text. `Donor genomes` is
# carried alongside so the difference between the two units stays visible.
case_ids <- c("EP01030", "P10K-NCBI-001938")
case_reps <- cont %>% filter(euka %in% case_ids) %>% pull(rep) %>% unique()

cooc_case <- cont %>%
  filter(euka %in% case_ids) %>%
  inner_join(
    mixed %>%
      filter(k != "Eukaryota", rep %in% case_reps) %>%
      transmute(rep, donor_mnemo = mnemo,
                Kingdom = k, Phylum = p, Family = f, Genus = g),
    by = "rep", relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Proteome = euka, Kingdom, Phylum, Family, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    `Flagged proteins` = n_distinct(seq),
    `Donor genomes`    = n_distinct(donor_mnemo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Proteome, desc(`Flagged proteins`))

rm(mixed, cont)
invisible(gc())

# eukaryote-eukaryote, across phyla; thresholded here (see params$euka_cooc_min)
euka_cooc <- pair_cooc %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("q" = "mnemo")) %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("t" = "mnemo")) %>%
  filter(k.x == "Eukaryota", k.y == "Eukaryota", p.x != p.y,
         n >= P$euka_cooc_min) %>%
  select(q, t, n, p.x, p.y, s.x, s.y)

# viral co-occurrence, pre-aggregated into the two tables the report shows
virus_mnemos <- virus_df$mnemo
viral_pairs <- pair_cooc %>%
  filter(q %in% virus_mnemos | t %in% virus_mnemos) %>%
  mutate(
    virus = ifelse(q %in% virus_mnemos, q, t),
    rest  = ifelse(q %in% virus_mnemos, t, q)
  ) %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("virus" = "mnemo")) %>%
  left_join(tax, by = c("rest" = "mnemo"))

viral_cooc <- viral_pairs %>%
  filter(k.y != "Viruses") %>%
  group_by(`Viral class` = c.x, `Non-viral phylum` = p.y) %>%
  summarise(`Summed co-occurrence` = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(`Summed co-occurrence`))

viral_cooc_megavir <- viral_pairs %>%
  filter(c.x == "Megaviricetes", p.y == "Diaphoretickes") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  transmute(Virus = virus, `Viral class` = c.x, Partner = rest,
            `Partner species` = s.y, `Co-occurrence` = n) %>%
  head(50)

message("cooc_by_genus: ", nrow(cooc_by_genus), " rows (donor genomes per genus) | euka_cooc: ",
        nrow(euka_cooc), " | viral_cooc: ", nrow(viral_cooc))

rm(pair_cooc, mixed_pairs, viral_pairs)
invisible(gc())
```

# nr / ClusteredNR

```{bash count-nr, eval=FALSE, engine="sh"}
cd /gpfs/projects/bsc40/databases/nr

blastdbcmd -db nr -entry all -outfmt "%a %T" > nr.fna.taxidmapping

LC_ALL=C awk -F' ' '{count[$2]++} END {for (i in count) print i"\t"count[i]}' nr.fna.taxidmapping | taxonkit reformat -I 1 -f "{C}\t{a}\t{r}\t{d}\t{p}\t{c}\t{o}\t{f}" --data-dir taxonomy > nr_taxid_counts_tax.tsv

echo 562 | taxonkit list | grep . > ecoli.ids
```

```{r nr}
nr_classes <- clustnr_classes <- reduction_nr <- NULL
nr_totals <- ecoli_counts <- NULL

if (HAVE_NR) {
  nr_cols <- c("taxid", "n", "cell", "acell", "r", "k", "p", "c", "o", "f")
  read_nr_counts <- function(path, db) {
    read_delim(path, col_names = nr_cols, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(!is.na(cell) | !is.na(acell)) %>%
      mutate(k = case_when(acell == "Viruses" ~ acell, .default = k), db = db) %>%
      select(-acell, -r, -cell)
  }
  nr_num      <- read_nr_counts(P$nr_counts, "nr")
  clustnr_num <- read_nr_counts(P$clustnr_counts, "clustnr")

  nr_classes <- nr_num %>% group_by(k, p, c) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(db = "nr")
  clustnr_classes <- clustnr_num %>% group_by(k, p, c) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(db = "clustnr")

  nr_totals <- c(nr = sum(nr_num$n), clustnr = sum(clustnr_num$n))

  reduction_nr <- bind_rows(
    group_by(nr_num, db, k, p, c) %>% summarise(num_seqs = sum(n), .groups = "drop"),
    group_by(clustnr_num, db, k, p, c) %>% summarise(num_seqs = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = db, values_from = num_seqs) %>%
    mutate(db = "nr", size = clustnr, reduction = nr - clustnr,
           prop_reduction = reduction / nr) %>%
    arrange(desc(prop_reduction)) %>%
    select(-nr, -clustnr) %>% ungroup()

  if (HAVE_ECOLI) {
    ecoli <- as.numeric(readLines(rp(P$ecoli_ids)))
    ecoli_counts <- c(
      nr      = sum(filter(nr_num, taxid %in% ecoli)$n),
      clustnr = sum(filter(clustnr_num, taxid %in% ecoli)$n)
    )
  }
  message("nr: ", format(nr_totals[["nr"]], big.mark = ","), " sequences")
  rm(nr_num, clustnr_num)
  invisible(gc())
}
```

# Write the bundle

```{r save-bundle}
bundle_meta <- list(
  created      = Sys.time(),
  host         = Sys.info()[["nodename"]],
  r_version    = R.version.string,
  results_dir  = normalizePath(rp(P$results), mustWork = FALSE),
  params       = P,
  have         = c(trees = HAVE_TREES, nr = HAVE_NR, ecoli = HAVE_ECOLI,
                   contam_file = HAVE_CONTAM_FILE),
  n_organisms  = nrow(repdb_df),
  git_commit   = tryCatch(
    system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE, ignore.stderr = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NA_character_)
)

BUNDLE <- c(
  # core
  "repdb_df", "clust_stats", "virus_df", "virus_groups", "p_order",
  "contam_check", "contam_file", "footprint", "bench_build",
  # trees (NULL when absent)
  "eukaproka_tree", "virtree", "repdb_classtree",
  # co-occurrence aggregates
  "cooc_by_genus", "cooc_case", "euka_cooc", "viral_cooc", "viral_cooc_megavir",
  # nr side (NULL when absent)
  "nr_classes", "clustnr_classes", "reduction_nr", "nr_totals", "ecoli_counts",
  # flags + provenance
  "HAVE_TREES", "HAVE_NR", "HAVE_ECOLI", "HAVE_CONTAM_FILE", "bundle_meta"
)

out <- rp(P$bundle)
dir.create(dirname(out), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
save(list = BUNDLE, file = out, compress = "gzip")

sizes <- tibble(
  Object = BUNDLE,
  Rows = map_chr(BUNDLE, function(o) {
    x <- get(o)
    if (is.data.frame(x)) format(nrow(x), big.mark = ",") else "-"
  }),
  MB = map_dbl(BUNDLE, ~ as.numeric(object.size(get(.x))) / 2^20)
) %>% arrange(desc(MB))

knitr::kable(sizes, digits = 2,
  caption = sprintf("Bundle contents. File: %s (%.1f MB on disk).",
                    out, file.size(out) / 2^20))
```

```{r done, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf("\n**Wrote `%s` (%.1f MB).** Copy that one file to the laptop and render `eda_report.Rmd` against it.\n",
            out, file.size(out) / 2^20))
```
